claims.quote: You can still make an online application to the DAF
claims.note: The DAF application page explicitly allows an online application.

claims.quote: You can also apply by post or phone via the details on our Contact us page
claims.note: The DAF application page explicitly allows applying by phone.

claims.claim: Applicants must be aged 16 or over
claims.quote: Applicants must be 16 or over and reside in Wales at the time of application and award.
claims.note: The review page states 16 or over, but the eligibility page says over 16 for both grant types, leaving age 16 inconsistent.

claims.quote: Applicants Identity has been verified in line with DWP records.
claims.note: Identity verification is stated, but no applicant-supplied proof document is specified.

claims.claim: Proof of Welsh residency is required
claims.quote: Applicants must be 16 or over and reside in Wales at the time of application and award.
claims.note: Welsh residence is an eligibility condition, but the sources do not specify proof of residence.

claims.claim: Details of the emergency or need are required
claims.quote: to assess if there is a need for financial assistance to be granted to the client
claims.note: The source says the application is assessed for need, but does not specify the emergency details applicants must submit.

claims.claim: An EAP applicant is excluded after 3 EAP awards in a year
claims.quote: already received 3 grants within the the last 12 rolling month period i.e. not calendar or tax year
claims.note: The limit is three grants overall in a rolling 12-month period, not expressly three EAP awards in a calendar year.

claims.claim: An IAP applicant is excluded after 1 IAP award in a year
claims.note: No supplied source gives a one-IAP-per-year limit; the page only gives an overall three-grant limit in a rolling 12 months.
